about: Hand-checked matches for Chinese-list species that have no single eBird 2026 species. eBird keeps them as a subspecies group (issf), a form, or inside a larger species. Checked 2026-11-17 against the eBird taxonomy (zh_SIM, issf/form/spuh/slash). eBird's own importer suggested alplew1 for 华西柳莺.

Strix davidi.note: Pere David's Owl = Ural Owl subspecies davidi

Parus minor.note: Japanese Tit is part of Asian Tit (Parus cinereus); covers minor and commixtus

Cecropis striolata.note: Striated Swallow = Eastern Red-rumped Swallow [striolata Group]

Phylloscopus occisinensis.note: Alpine Leaf Warbler = Tickell's Leaf Warbler (Alpine); eBird's importer suggests this

Garrulax owstoni.note: Hainan Hwamei is included in Chinese Hwamei (Garrulax canorus)

Carpodacus lepidus.note: Chinese Long-tailed Rosefinch = Long-tailed Rosefinch lepidus/henrici

Emberiza yunnanensis.note: Southern Rock Bunting = Godlewski's Bunting yunnanensis/khamensis

left_unmatched.Gypsophila huanjiangensis: Huanjiang Wren-Babbler (described 2022) is not in eBird yet; the nearest is the spuh liwbab1 (annamensis/calcicola/crispifrons), which does not include it. Choose by hand.
